description: Optional inspiration palette of experimental structures. NOT consulted by runtime routing.

structures.name: Two-arm RCT
structures.description: Treatment vs control, random allocation; gold standard for clinical efficacy under ethics constraints.

structures.name: Factorial RCT
structures.description: Multiple interventions varied independently; allows interaction effects but enlarges sample size.

structures.name: Prospective cohort
structures.description: Define population, measure exposure, follow forward in time. Stronger than retrospective; weaker than RCT.

structures.name: Case-control
structures.description: Identify cases, match controls, look backward at exposure. Useful for rare outcomes.

structures.name: Cross-sectional
structures.description: Snapshot exposure and outcome simultaneously. Cannot establish temporal precedence.

structures.name: N-of-1 / single-subject
structures.description: Repeated measures on one subject with crossover. Useful when individual response varies more than population mean.

structures.name: Natural-experiment / quasi-experimental
structures.description: Exploits policy changes, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity. For non-randomizable interventions.

structures.name: In-silico simulation
structures.description: Computational model of a system; useful when physical experiments are expensive, slow, or unethical. Mechanism must be specified.
